data.narrative:
Simbe Robotics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public peer (ticker 277810.KQ) operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $100M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $170M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—including Exotec ($2.0B Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), and Hadrian ($1.6B Series D)—yielding a median valuation of $1.6B with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce substantial divergence. The stage-progression approach yields $170M; peer comps center at $1.6B. Triangulating these results across both methods produces a valuation range of $144M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $910M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Simbe's growth trajectory and unit economics track closer to seed-stage comparables or to more mature Series D peers. Reconciling this range requires deeper analysis of revenue traction, capital efficiency, and customer concentration relative to the peer set.
